system: Railway Mitra Folder Identification Code System
algorithm: SHA-256 of normalized feature-folder path; first 64 bits displayed as uppercase hexadecimal
stability: Codes remain stable across devices and sessions while the folder path remains unchanged.
scope: Feature pages under /features/. The Home Screen is explicitly excluded.
futureFolders: Any future feature folder receives its code automatically on pages that load folder-codes.js.
display: Small, muted badge appended in normal document flow after page content; never absolutely positioned or overlaid.
